package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for middleware_allocates_db_or_gorm_handle_per_request: Database or GORM connections opened inside handlers or middleware instead of process-level setup.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func DBCreateMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(":memory:"), &gorm.Config{})
		if err != nil {
			c.AbortWithStatusJSON(500, gin.H{"error": "db connect failed"})
			return
		}
		sqlDB, _ := db.DB()
		defer sqlDB.Close()

		var result map[string]interface{}
		db.Raw("SELECT 1").Scan(&result)

		c.Set("db", db)
		c.Next()
	}
}

var _ = log.Println
